title: Django + Django REST Framework + Django ORM + PostgreSQL
apiDocs: drf-spectacular: schema at /api/schema, Swagger UI at /api/docs
conventions: Expose OpenAPI/Swagger by default with drf-spectacular: SpectacularAPIView at /api/schema and SpectacularSwaggerView at /api/docs; add DEFAULT_SCHEMA_CLASS and annotate views with @extend_schema so every action and resource appears in the document for the frontend to bind to.
Layer as models.py (Django models + migrations) / serializers.py (DRF request/response) / services.py (command handlers) / views.py (DRF APIViews) / permissions.py (DRF permission classes).
identity attributes are the Django primary key; UUIDs use models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4).
Optimistic concurrency: an IntegerField `version`; UpdateCustomer uses Customer.objects.filter(pk=id, version=expected).update(name=..., version=F('version')+1) and treats a 0-row result as HTTP 409.
Atomic commands wrap the write in transaction.atomic().
Conditional idempotency: return 200 unchanged if the mutate-listed fields already match.
Authorization: a DRF permission class mapping to the named policy (CustomerUpdatePolicy) guards the view.
Lifecycles map to TextChoices + a transition guard raising ValidationError; only declared transitions are allowed.
A command may only write the fields in the action's `mutate` set.

Realize each action by its operation+scope: record CRUD (create→POST, read/exists/count→GET, replace→PUT, patch/update→PATCH, delete→DELETE, upsert→idempotent PUT); bulk-*/scope=set → a batch endpoint honoring atomicity (transaction.atomic vs per-record); each collectionTransforms entry (filter/map/group/aggregate/join/…) → a query/aggregate endpoint or a DB view. Annotate each so it appears in the drf-spectacular schema.
Tests use pytest-django with @pytest.mark.django_db, covering happy path, illegal transition, and stale-version 409.
